title: The S&P 500 is on track for its worst November since 2008
summary: The S&P 500 is on track for its worst November since 2008The S&P 500 has declined about 1.5-2% in November 2025 so far, marking a potential worst month since 2008, but it's more of a pullback than a crash.P.S.: Equity volatility alone isn’t a crisis indicator. The real signals to watch are funding spreads, repo market behavior, and credit condition.submitted by/u/FeatureAggravating75[link][comments]
